snippet.title: Muramasa: Revenant Blades - Gameplay Showcase
snippet.description:
Get a closer look at the combat and exploration, newly updated localization featuring English voiceover, and visual enhancements that bring Vanillaware’s gorgeous characters and world to life with stunning 4K clarity in this all-new gameplay showcase for Muramasa: Revenant Blades!

Experience the ultimate expression of this stunning action game when Muramasa: Revenant Blades arrives on PC, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 on Feb. 4, 2027!

Learn more: https://bit.ly/MuramasaRB

Originally released for the Wii in 2009 and PlayStation Vita in 2013, the Vanillaware x Marvelous 2D action-RPG has been refined for modern hardware with support for up to 4K resolution, new combat and weapon systems, as well as additional modes and gameplay options. Muramasa: Revenant Blades will also feature original protagonists Momohime and Kisuke alongside Okoi, Gonbe, Arashimaru, and Rajaki – all originally introduced in the PlayStation Vita version – allowing players to experience all six unique storylines in any order they choose from the start.
